page.overview:
Who is Towga Gremlin?

In Cars 2, he first appears as one of the lemons cornering Finn McMissile on one of the oil rigs. In an attempt to kill Finn, Towga uses a blowtorch, but Finn reverses off the oil rig and into the ocean. Later, in Tokyo, Towga, with Fred Pacer and a Trunkov push Finn toward Acer with a flame-thrower, but Finn leaps, causing Towga to collide with Acer. The explosion that occurs sends them both up into the air. Luckily, Acer lands on a sushi sign, but unfortunately for Towga, he is not so lucky. What happened to him afterward is unknown. But it can be inferred that he may have fallen to his death somewhere.

Towga was a cold-hearted terrorist who was serving Professor Zündapp and Miles Axlerod on the Lemons' Oil Rig. He also killed Leland Turbo and attempted to kill Finn McMissile.
